notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 timestamped regional attribute alternate-advance surface. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, dimensional FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies one regional attribute passel through Flush Queue Request, Time Advance Request Available, and Next Message Request Available, preserves source-region and retraction metadata, checks reflection-before-grant and logical-time bounds, and rejects invalid backward requests without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador timestamped regional attribute delivery through Flush Queue Request, Time Advance Request Available, and Next Message Request Available with FederateAmbassador reflection and grant callbacks
